328	Teague created the "station-gain" line to track accounting reality:

341	### Teague's Theory on Arrangement
342	Testimony to board of arbitration (and repeated in 1948):
343	> Cream is portable, and that station was in one pair of hands for twenty-nine seasons. I say that a business which is arranged so that a single man can take a little and write down a little less is a business that will sooner or later have a little taken from it, and that no set of books ever made can prevent it.
